candidate.headline: Senior AI & Machine Learning Engineer
candidate.veteranStatus: I am not a protected veteran

summary: Senior AI and Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years designing, deploying, and optimizing enterprise-grade distributed ML pipelines, predictive analytics systems, and high-concurrency microservices. Proven track record at Uber Eats, EY, and Coca-Cola delivering real-time recommendation engines, fraud detection architectures, and autonomous AI systems at billion-request scale.

cloudDevOps: AWS (SageMaker, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB)

highlights: Architected distributed real-time delivery estimation and dynamic dispatch ranking models serving 45M+ monthly active eaters with sub-18ms p99 latency.
Engineered automated feature drift and model observability pipelines on AWS and Kafka, reducing production incident triage time by 52%.
Mentored a cross-functional pod of 5 machine learning and backend engineers, standardizing MLflow model governance and zero-downtime canary deployment protocols.
Led engineering of enterprise anomaly detection and automated risk-scoring platforms across Fortune 500 audit clients, processing $12B+ in transactional ledgers.
Scaled deep learning NLP models for unstructured financial document extraction using BERT and PyTorch, achieving 96.4% precision and reducing manual audit overhead by 60%.
Designed secure multi-tenant data pipelines on AWS (ECS, RDS, S3) meeting strict SOC2 and ISO27001 compliance standards.
Developed predictive supply chain demand forecasting algorithms using gradient boosted trees and time-series models across North American bottling operations.
Automated batch ETL pipelines using Apache Spark and Python, accelerating daily inventory syncs from 6 hours to 45 minutes.
Implemented high-performance bioinformatics data processing modules in Python and C++, optimizing genomic sequence alignment algorithms.
Constructed RESTful API endpoints and PostgreSQL database schemas supporting academic and clinical research platforms.

screeningAnswers.whyCompany: I am passionate about solving mission-critical business challenges through scalable, high-throughput machine learning architectures and distributed systems. Having engineered real-time AI and predictive services at Uber Eats, EY, and Coca-Cola, your company's technical vision, data scale, and engineering culture directly align with my expertise.
screeningAnswers.greatestAchievement: At Uber Eats, I spearheaded the redesign of our dynamic delivery dispatch ranking system, achieving sub-18ms p99 inference latency across 45M+ monthly active users and delivering a 7.4% improvement in courier dispatch efficiency while sustaining 99.99% system availability.
screeningAnswers.technicalExperience: 8+ years building enterprise AI/ML solutions in Python, Go, and TypeScript, containerized on Kubernetes and AWS (SageMaker, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS). Deep expertise in distributed training, real-time feature stores, streaming architectures with Kafka, and production model governance.
screeningAnswers.workStyle: I thrive in high-ownership, collaborative, async-first engineering environments where clear communication, automated test coverage, and continuous delivery enable rapid engineering velocity without compromising production reliability.
